name: Sofia Vargas
bio:
Sofia Vargas's passion for motorsport sparked during her childhood in Bogota, watching the Formula 1 races with her grandfather. This early fascination led her to pursue a degree in Finance, with the ultimate goal of combining her analytical skills with her love for racing. After graduating, she secured an internship at a local racing team, gaining valuable experience in managing budgets and financial planning.

Sofia is known for her meticulous attention to detail and her ability to remain calm and focused under pressure. She believes in fostering a collaborative environment, working closely with team members to ensure financial goals are aligned with the team's overall objectives. Her ambition is to contribute to the long-term success of Racing Bulls by optimizing financial strategies and driving sustainable growth. Her fresh perspective and eagerness to learn make her a valuable asset to the team.

What sets Sofia apart is her innovative approach to financial problem-solving. She consistently seeks out opportunities to streamline processes and identify cost-saving measures, always looking for ways to improve efficiency and maximize resources.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied in a high ponytail.
physical.description: Sofia is of medium height with a sporty build and a warm, friendly smile.
